name: token-saver
description: Route tasks through focused workflows and report auditable token savings.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks through efficient context workflows.
interface.longDescription: Automatically choose focused or full-fidelity workflows, capture a pre-filter baseline, preserve high-risk evidence, then report an honest token receipt.
defaultPrompt: Use $token-saver to choose the smallest useful context workflow for this task.
Use $token-audit to find avoidable context costs.
Use $errors-only to run tests without dumping logs.
Use $full-fidelity when this review must not omit unique evidence.
